alex (Marketing): Morning — final check before we blast the press + announce tomorrow. Need: final changelog blurb, docs landing link, confirmed webinar slot, and routing for inbound leads. Can we lock these by EOD? :rocket:

maria (Docs): I can post the docs link once changelog blurb is final. @jamal any changes to the API surface to call out?

jamal (Eng): No API changes. Only infra notes: model routing defaults changed for canary traffic. Will paste a short changelog line in a sec.

jamal (Eng): ```Changelog: v2.3.0 - improved routing: canary policy for new RL agents, reduced cold-start latency, patched batching bug.```

sophie (PM): Webinar slot confirmed: Tue 10am PT. Can marketing use that in the announce header?

alex (Marketing): yes, include "Live demo + benchmarks" callout. Also need a docs landing URL (prod) and a short "what's new" bullet (<=2 lines).

maria (Docs): Publishing from staging to prod at 5pm PT. Prod URL will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-v2-3 (placeholder — will update). I'll add a "Quick start" section.

jamal (Eng): tagging the canary window: 5:30pm-6:30pm PT Tue. If rollouts fail we'll fallback to v2.2 automatically.

alex (Marketing): Perfect. Can someone drop a one-liner changelog we can copy into the tweet/thread?

sophie (PM): One-liner suggestion: "v2.3 reduces inference cold-start by ~35% and adds canary routing for safer rollouts."

maria (Docs): I'll convert that into a short paragraph for docs.

jamal (Eng): Ops note: please add the deploy-bot alert channel to the announce so SRE sees any traffic spikes: #eng-oncall
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary rollout starts 2027-09-14T17:30:00Z -> monitoring enabled.

alex (Marketing): Thx — I will draft the post and share for quick review 30m before send. Anyone want to add final phrasing?

sophie (PM): Add a line about cost/perf tradeoffs we measured in the bench.

maria (Docs): Also adding "migration notes" at the top for customers on dedicated plans.

alex (Marketing): Awesome. Locking EOD: marketing will send draft at 4:30pm PT for 30m review. :email:

jamal (Eng): I'll be on standby during the canary window.

maria (Docs): Prod link will be final by 5pm PT; I'll ping here with the exact URL.

alex (Marketing): Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the draft in 30. :rocket:
